replies.body:
In terms of aesthetics it doesn't look consistent. I suggest adding more to the map and all what not. Make a nuclear design on the Power plants themselves each with the color of the team it belongs to.

Now, in terms of PVP gameplay it will be pretty straightforward and simple. Its great but it needs to be more dynamic; add hills.

Now, getting the objective will be a hassle as pretty much its a skinny lane and you can easily be seen when trying to go to it and mine it.

I suggest adding more objectives and fixing the placement of the current objective

This map like all maps have potential :)

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Sorry! :(

We're sorry to announce that your map has been denied for testing on the Avicus Network. The reasons are the following:

- Too flat. The map doesn't really offer terrain, which lowers game-play quality. Try adding some hills, small holes in the ground, etc.

- Aesthetics factor. The outside of the buildings look somewhat plain. Try adding some designs/details along the outside of the structures, and perhaps even on the trees!

- Less variations in blocks. As triplezko suggested, try adding more blocks (like stone) underground rather then it just being dirt.

You may rework your map and update it so we can re-evaluate it. Please use only one forum submission per map, update this thread once you're done. Good luck!

Overall Score:
Gameplay: 6.5/10
Aesthetics: 5.5/10
Creativity: 8/10

Thanks for your map submission! :D
